=== Flame Text Banner Block ===
Contributors: WordPress Telex Tags: block, banner, flame, text effect, animation Tested up to: 6.8 Stable tag: 0.1.0 License: GPLv2 or later License URI: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html A striking banner block that renders text with animated flame effects rising from the letters.
== Description ==
The Flame Text Banner Block lets you create eye-catching banners with animated fire effects on your text. Flames dance and flicker realistically above each letter, creating a dramatic visual impact perfect for headlines, call-to-action sections, or any content that needs to stand out.
**Features:**
* Fully customizable banner text * Animated flame particles that rise from each letter * Configurable flame color scheme (inner and outer flame colors) * Adjustable text size (small, medium, large, extra-large) * Dark background with customizable overlay * Smooth, performant CSS and canvas-based animation * Responsive design that works on all screen sizes * Live preview in the block editor
== Installation ==
1. Upload the plugin files to the `/wp-content/plugins/telex-flame-text-banner` directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly. 2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' screen in WordPress 3. In the block editor, search for "Flame Text Banner" and insert it into your content. 4. Type your desired text and customize the flame appearance using the block sidebar controls.
== Frequently Asked Questions ==
= Can I change the flame colors? =
Yes! Use the block sidebar controls to set both the inner (bright) and outer flame colors for a custom fire look.
= Does this affect page performance? =
The animation uses an efficient canvas-based particle system that pauses when the block is not visible on screen, ensuring minimal performance impact.
= Can I adjust the text size? =
Yes, you can choose from four text size presets: Small, Medium, Large, and Extra Large.
== Screenshots ==
1. Flame Text Banner block in action with default orange/red flames. 2. Block editor sidebar controls for customizing flame appearance.
== Changelog ==
= 0.1.0 = * Initial release with animated flame text effect * Customizable flame colors, text size, and banner text

<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name:       Flame Text Banner Block
 * Description:       A striking banner block that renders text with animated flame effects rising from the letters.
 * Version:           0.1.0
 * Requires at least: 6.7
 * Requires PHP:      7.4
 * Author:            WordPress Telex
 * License:           GPLv2 or later
 * License URI:       https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html
 * Text Domain:       telex-flame-text-banner
 *
 * @package TelexFlameTextBanner
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit; // Exit if accessed directly.
}
/**
 * Registers the block using the metadata loaded from the `block.json` file.
 * Behind the scenes, it registers also all assets so they can be enqueued
 * through the block editor in the corresponding context.
 *
 * @see https://developer.wordpress.org/reference/functions/register_block_type/
 */
if ( ! function_exists( 'telex_flame_text_banner_telex_flame_text_banner_block_init' ) ) {
	function telex_flame_text_banner_telex_flame_text_banner_block_init(): void {
		register_block_type( __DIR__ . '/build/' );
	}
}
add_action( 'init', 'telex_flame_text_banner_telex_flame_text_banner_block_init' );
